decision_basis: assignment docs/decisions.md section 23 ('a per-taxpayer Comptroller detail URL is added only once its form is confirmed under US egress, and the bulk page is never written as a company's source_http_request') and api-contract.md BusinessRecord.detail_url ('the Comptroller's per-taxpayer detail URL, once its form is confirmed under US egress; never the bulk dataset page'); no field is added

probe.probe_taxpayer: the first Texas profit corporation (organizational type CT) with an SOS file number in the Travis cache; the number itself is not recorded here
probe.title: FRANCHISE TAX ACCOUNT STATUS
probe.record_fields_in_html: none: the page is a shell with a skeleton loader; its script calls fetch(apiUrl) and renders the account from the JSON
probe.data_endpoint: https://comptroller.texas.gov/data-search/franchise-tax/<taxpayer_number> (named by the page; not requested in the window)

decision.detail_url: https://comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/franchise/account-status/search/<taxpayer_number>, the trimmed printed 11-digit taxpayer number of a franchise-tax row
decision.applies_to: tx-comptroller-franchise-tax rows only (every row of 2026-10-17 prints an 11-digit number: 342,334 Travis rows, 3,487,662 statewide)
null_for: tx-comptroller-sales-tax rows: the page is the franchise account status and was probed for a franchise taxpayer only; a withheld sole owner's number is never put in a URL
tx-sos-veteran-owned-business rows: keyed by SOS filing number, no taxpayer page was probed for them
any row whose number is withheld or not 11 digits
decision.form_confirmed_because: under US egress the URL answers HTTP 200 without a redirect and returns a page generated for that taxpayer (its own data endpoint and its share links carry the same number)
decision.not_provenance: the HTML holds no record field, so the URL does not confirm the record and backs no field: no source_http_request, request_identifier or unpublished_source names it; a business record's provenance stays its bulk page request (unpublished_source.source_http_request). The probe's confirmation rule ('until then no company carries a per-taxpayer source_http_request') therefore still holds, and in v1 no company record is written at all
decision.optional_confirmation: one GET of the data-search endpoint for the probe taxpayer under US egress would show whether it serves the record; it is not needed for a link and is not part of the TSBPE re-run
